basic_details.job_title: Mormugao Port Authority Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mormugao Port Authority invites applications from eligible officers of all Major Port Authorities for 1 post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer in the Engineering Mechanical Department on a revised pay scale of Rs. 80,000–2,20,000 (pre-revised Rs. 32,900–58,000 / Rs. 16,000–20,800) by absorption through composite method. Applicants must hold a degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university or institution with 12 years of executive cadre experience in the relevant discipline. age_limit.details: The upper age limit prescribed for direct recruitment is 42 years as on 01 March 2027. Under the Recruitment Rules, the age limit does not apply in the case of promotion or absorption.

qualification.details: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university or institution.

how_to_apply: Open the Online Application Portal (OAP) hosted by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
Fill in and submit the application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer online between 23 October 2026 and 22 November 2026.
Download and print the completed online application form.
Affix a self-attested recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
Enclose attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and the signed self-undertaking on non-withdrawal of candidature (Annexure-IV).
Submit the application package through proper channel to the parent Port Authority administration for verification and forwarding.

Ensure the envelope carrying the forwarded application is superscribed with "Application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer under Engineering Mechanical Dept., in Mormugao Port Authority".

The parent Port must forward the application along with all prescribed clearances so that it reaches Secretary, Mormugao Port Authority, "Saarasi" General Administration Department, Administrative Office Building, Headland, Sada, Goa - 403 804 on or before 07 December 2026.
important_instructions: In case an advance copy of the application is submitted by any candidate, the candidature will not be considered if the application is not received through proper channel from the parent Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications (on or before 07 December 2026). Incomplete applications or applications received after 07 December 2026 or applications not routed through proper channel will be rejected. As per Ministry instructions dated 11 August 2021, any Port official who withdraws candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be debarred from future selection to Deputy HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years. Candidates must execute an undertaking (Annexure-IV) confirming that they will not withdraw their candidature if selected by the Services Selection Committee. The parent Port Authority must forward attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), year-wise grading statements, administrative clearance (Annexure-II), vigilance clearance (Annexure-III), a No Objection Certificate (Annexure-V), service particulars (Annexure-VI), and details of any penalties imposed during the last 10 years. The parent Port Authority must verify and certify the veracity of university certificates and recognition of degrees obtained by the applicant. No application other than the application uploaded in OAP will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities who satisfy the prescribed qualifications, experience, and service requirements. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria with respect to qualification, experience, and age is 01 March 2027. Degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university or institution. Twelve years of experience in the relevant discipline in executive cadre in an industrial, commercial, or government undertaking. The upper age limit prescribed for direct recruitment is 42 years as on 01 March 2027. Under the Recruitment Rules, the age limit does not apply in the case of promotion or absorption. Officers serving in Major Port Trusts/Authorities must meet one of the following criteria: Officers holding analogous posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 16,000–20,800 in the Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust. Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Department with 3 years of regular service in the grade in the scale of Rs. 13,000–18,250 in a Major Port Trust. Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Department with 2 years of regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scale of pay of Rs. 10,750–16,750 and Rs. 13,000–18,250 in the respective discipline in a Major Port Trust. Officers holding analogous posts or officers holding the post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 13,000–18,250 with 3 years of regular service in the grade in the respective discipline in Government, PSUs, or Autonomous bodies are eligible. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected officer will be appointed to the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer in the Engineering Mechanical Department of Mormugao Port Authority in the scale of Rs. 80,000–2,20,000/- (pre-revised scale Rs. 32,900–58,000 / Rs. 16,000–400–20,800). The appointment will be on Composite Method and governed by the Port Service Rules and Regulations in force and as amended from time to time. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPA Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer
content_sections.text: Open the Online Application Portal (OAP) hosted by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. Fill in and submit the application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer online between 23 October 2026 and 22 November 2026. Download and print the completed online application form. Affix a self-attested recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form. Enclose attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and the signed self-undertaking on non-withdrawal of candidature (Annexure-IV). Submit the application package through proper channel to the parent Port Authority administration for verification and forwarding. Ensure the envelope carrying the forwarded application is superscribed with "Application for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer under Engineering Mechanical Dept., in Mormugao Port Authority". The parent Port must forward the application along with all prescribed clearances so that it reaches Secretary, Mormugao Port Authority, "Saarasi" General Administration Department, Administrative Office Building, Headland, Sada, Goa - 403 804 on or before 07 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is made on merit through the composite method by the Services Selection Committee. The benchmark for selection requires that the overall grading in ACRs/APARs for the preceding five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) shall not be below "Very Good".

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under MPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mormugao Port Authority has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for MPA Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer?
faq.answer: The online application portal remains open until 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. By what date must the hard copy application reach Mormugao Port Authority?
faq.answer: The printout forwarded through proper channel must reach the Mormugao Port Authority office on or before 07 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university or institution.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is needed for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must have 12 years of experience in the relevant discipline in executive cadre in an industrial, commercial, or government undertaking.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for MPA Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer?
faq.answer: The post carries a revised pay scale of Rs. 80,000–2,20,000 (pre-revised scale Rs. 32,900–58,000 / Rs. 16,000–20,800).

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years as on the crucial eligibility date of 01 March 2027, but the age limit does not apply in the case of promotion or absorption.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit through the composite method by the Services Selection Committee, requiring an ACR/APAR benchmark grading of not below "Very Good".

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be submitted along with the application printout?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, an undertaking on non-withdrawal of candidature, and two recent colour passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What penalty applies if an officer withdraws candidature after selection?
faq.answer: Any officer who withdraws candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be debarred from selection to Deputy HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.
